title: Dynamic evaluation via DRb.start_service (ruby) — review required
description: The ruby call DRb.start_service resolves, renders, or loads dynamically. Untrusted input becomes code execution or unsafe output. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms trust or replaces it with no DRb or local-only ACL.
remediation: Replace with no DRb or local-only ACL.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any DRb.start_service call matches.
